factor.name: truck_pick_z_offset_m
factor.profile: constant world-Z translation of every returned agibot/subtask0/toy_truck waypoint, after source selection and object transform, before merging/execution; clone poses; all other fields and subtask1(box) unchanged

performance_selection.multiple_attempts: Bonferroni budget for at most2 new experiments; each alpha.025
performance_selection.test: unpaired pooled two-proportion z; scipy norm.sf; no continuity correction

mechanism.M1: successful generated first-close truck-frame actual EEF z median <= E2 median-3mm and <10mm
mechanism.M2: all first-near-close rollout truck-frame actual EEF z median <= E2 median-3mm; no-near-close trials excluded and separately counted
mechanism.M3: first-secured slip proportion below E2 42/78 at one-sided pooled two-proportion z p<.05

verdict.supported: performance_selection passes AND M1 AND M2 AND M3
verdict.rejected: pooled successes <=40 OR M1 fails OR M2 fails OR first-secured slip rate >=42/78
verdict.inconclusive: all other outcomes; performance selection remains separate
verdict.generation_gate_failure: H4 implementation/feasibility failure; no training, preserve evidence, no delta tuning under H4

constraints: BC config seed only; restore exact seed101 bytes
one Kit;3GiB RAM guard;owned PIDs only
same stock matching;no yaw fold;D3scope6 flags unchanged
